ways.label: Tangihua Lions Lodge to the Tangihua Main Ridge Track / Northern Tangihua Track junction

end.name: junction of the Tangihua Main Ridge Track and the Northern Tangihua Track
end.quote: junction of the Tangihua Main Ridge Track

ways.time: 3 hr 45 min to junction one way from car park
evidence: From the Tangihua Lions Lodge you walk past the orientation course and clearings to enter a bush track.

From here the Te Haua Uru Track continues to climb steeply up to the junction of the Tangihua Main Ridge Track which leads to the Horokaka Transmitter (an additional 2 - 3 hours tramp) and the Northern Tangihua Track which leads to the Tangihua Hut (an additional 2 - 3 hours tramp).

ways.label: Day walk as far as Kauri Grove
evidence: Day walkers can easily walk as far as Kauri Grove accessed from the Te Haua Uru Track.

access_points.name: Omana Road Tangihua access car park
access_points.quote: Omana Road Tangihua access car park

doubts: The description starts at Tangihua Lions Lodge, but DOC's time is 'from car park' (the Omana Road car park, 45 min walk from the lodge along a formed road); I used the lodge as start and the car park as an access point. No feature or entry for the lodge, car park or the end junction, so they have no ref. The 'Tumanako Track' is both a link (L1, the Whakapapono and Tumanako tracks walk) and a map track (T5); I gave T5 as the track followed. The Kauri Grove option does not state its return; taken as out and back from 'as far as'. The 9-hour Te Haua Uru-Main Ridge-Horokaka loop is a longer combination using other tracks and is not recorded as a way.
